title: Développeur Salesforce confirmé / Senior (H/F)

title: Chef de Projet Transverse Salesforce & Intégration de Données Azure (H/F)
text: Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre de l'évolution de son écosystème CRM, notre client recherche un Chef de Projet Transverse Salesforce capable de piloter des projets IT de bout en bout et de coordonner les différents acteurs métiers et techniques. Vous interviendrez sur un environnement Salesforce multi-cloud comprenant Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, Field Service et Marketing Cloud, ainsi que sur les sujets d'intégration et de circulation des données via Azure Data Factory. Votre rôle sera de garantir la bonne réalisation des projets, du cadrage jusqu'à la mise en production, en assurant le respect des délais, des budgets, de la qualité et des engagements. Vos principales missions Pilotage et gestion de projets Recueillir et analyser les besoins métiers. Définir le périmètre, les objectifs, les budgets, les ressources et les plannings. Piloter les projets de bout en bout et suivre les engagements. Identifier les risques, anticiper les difficultés et gérer les plans d'action. Coordonner les équipes internes et les prestataires. Coordination Salesforce et Data Piloter les évolutions de l'écosystème Salesforce : Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, Field Service et Marketing Cloud. Coordonner les interactions entre les différentes solutions CRM. Superviser les projets d'intégration de données via Azure Data Factory. Assurer la cohérence des flux de données et des interfaces avec les systèmes partenaires. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les architectes et les équipes techniques. Recette et mise en production Définir et coordonner les stratégies de recette. Organiser les tests fonctionnels et les tests de bout en bout. Suivre les anomalies et garantir leur résolution. Préparer et coordonner les mises en production. Piloter la phase de stabilisation et le transfert aux équipes de support. Gouvernance et reporting Animer les comités projet et comités de pilotage. Assurer le suivi des budgets, des délais, des risques et des dépendances. Produire des reportings réguliers à destination des parties prenantes. Préparer les arbitrages et alerter sur les éventuels écarts. Minimum 7 ans d'expérience en gestion de projets IT. Au moins 3 ans d'expérience sur des projets Salesforce. Expérience confirmée dans le pilotage de projets CRM de bout en bout. Bonne connaissance des différents clouds Salesforce. Compréhension des architectures d'intégration, des API et des flux de données. Expérience sur Azure Data Factory ou une solution d'intégration équivalente. Maîtrise des méthodes Agile et cycle en V. Capacité à coordonner des équipes métiers, techniques et des prestataires. Anglais professionnel indispensable.

text:
Healthcare Salesforce Azure AWS Integration Architect Harmony Health is hiring a Salesforce integration architect to connect Salesforce and a HITRUST r2 AWS SFTP to the existing PCE platform on Azure, without breaking anything already built.

Title: Salesforce Integration Architect (Azure Data Factory + AWS, Healthcare/HITRUST r2): Patient File Intake & CSR Workflow

About the project
We're a healthcare services organization that runs a patient outreach and scheduling program for a health plan partner. We're moving our call-center workflow to Salesforce. We need an experienced integration architect to design, and optionally build, how patient data flows between our partner, AWS, Salesforce and our existing Azure platform. All of it must support our HITRUST r2 certification effort.

Current state
The health plan sends a monthly patient file. Today it lands on Azure SFTP and loads into Azure SQL through Azure Data Factory (ADF).
Azure SQL feeds our current scheduling list through Power Automate, sends a daily status file back to the health plan, and reconciles appointments from our EHR (athenahealth, via Snowflake).
Planned future state (our preferred design, open to expert review)
The health plan delivers the monthly file to a Harmony-branded SFTP on AWS Transfer Family, a HITRUST r2 in-scope service.
ADF pulls the file from S3 into our existing ingestion pipeline. Azure SQL stays the system of record.
ADF replaces our two Power Automate flows: (1) upsert members from Azure SQL into Salesforce on member ID, (2) sync CSR call attempts from Salesforce back into the existing Azure SQL tables. Downstream reporting and EHR reconciliation stay unchanged.

Phase 1: architecture and design, about 2 to 4 weeks
Validate or improve this design. Our priority is preserving the existing Azure pipelines.
Design the S3 to ADF handoff: credentials, triggering and HITRUST controls.
Map Salesforce fields and call outcomes to our existing contact-attempt tables.
Recommend the Salesforce data model (Lead/Contact vs. Person Account, Health Cloud fit) and the CSR routing approach (queues, tasks or Omni-Channel).
Design monitoring and alerting so a failed sync is caught the same day.
Plan a parallel-run cutover from the current scheduling list to Salesforce.
Map security decisions to HITRUST control areas across Azure, AWS and Salesforce.
Deliverables: future-state architecture diagram, field mapping, integration and error-handling design, HITRUST control mapping, and a Phase 2 build plan with estimate.

Phase 2 (optional, separate contract): build and test the ADF pipelines and Salesforce Flows, complete the AWS SFTP setup, and go live after a parallel run with test files from the health plan.
Required
Azure Data Factory, including the Salesforce connector, and Azure SQL.
Salesforce integration architecture. Integration Architect certification preferred.
AWS: Transfer Family/S3, IAM, KMS and CloudTrail.
Experience handling PHI under HIPAA. HITRUST r2 experience strongly preferred.
Batch integration: file intake, upsets, retries and reconciliation.
Nice to have
Salesforce Health Cloud
Salesforce Flow and Omni-Channel for call center routing
Payer eligibility files and PGP-encrypted file exchange
athenahealth integration
Requirements before you get access (HITRUST)
Sign an NDA and a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before you see architecture documents.
Work only through company-provisioned accounts with MFA. No PHI on personal devices.

Phase 1 is design-only with no PHI access. Phase 2 uses dummy data until go-live. A background check may be required for Phase 2.

To apply, please include

An integration you've designed spanning Salesforce and a cloud platform (Azure or AWS), and your role in it.
How you'd keep one source of truth when the file lands in AWS, CSRs work in Salesforce and reporting runs from Azure SQL.
How you'd make sure a daily status report never silently misses data when a sync fails.
Your experience in HIPAA or HITRUST r2 environments.
Your availability and estimated fixed price for Phase 1.

title: MarTech Solutions Architect (Tealium and/or Dynamic Yield, with Braze, Adobe or Salesforce)
text: MarTech Solutions Architect (Tealium and/or Dynamic Yield, with Braze, Adobe or Salesforce) MarTech Solutions Architect (Tealium and/or Dynamic Yield, with Braze, Adobe or Salesforce) Large consumer products end client working with an established consulting firm. The role We are looking for a MarTech Solutions Architect to design and lead the delivery of a connected customer data, personalisation and engagement stack. Tealium provides the data and tag layer, Dynamic Yield drives on-site personalisation and experimentation and Braze powers cross-channel engagement. These integrate with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) or Salesforce Marketing Cloud and the wider marketing technology estate. Experience across both Tealium and Dynamic Yield is beneficial, but we are equally happy to speak with candidates who have strong depth in one of the two. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end MarTech architecture, ensuring Tealium, Dynamic Yield, Braze and AEM (or Salesforce) align with business objectives and work together cleanly. Design and implement the customer data and tag layer, including Tealium iQ Tag Management, EventStream, AudienceStream, data governance and consent handling. Lead Dynamic Yield implementation: tagging and SDK integration, audience and affinity setup, product recommendations, personalisation and A/B testing, with data fed from Tealium. Deliver Braze implementation: SDK integration, API connections, data ingestion and configuration of campaigns, Canvases and Content Cards. Define how AEM content and experiences connect to personalisation and engagement tools (content fragments, experience fragments, decisioning). Act as primary technical consultant for the stack, giving strategic advice and best practice to marketing, product and engineering teams. Work with stakeholders to translate needs into technical requirements and actionable use cases. Partner with data and engineering teams to design and manage data flows, so the right data reaches each platform to power personalised customer journeys. Essential Strong hands-on experience in either Tealium (iQ, EventStream and/or AudienceStream) or Dynamic Yield (personalisation, experimentation and recommendations), in an architecture or technical lead capacity. Hands-on Braze experience, with at least two full-cycle implementations architected or led. Experience integrating CDP, tag management and personalisation tools into a coherent architecture, including ETL and data integration. Working knowledge of Adobe Experience Manager or Salesforce Marketing Cloud within a wider MarTech stack. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or similar IaC technologies. Experience with data technologies such as Kafka, Postgres, MongoDB or Redis. Broad awareness of MarTech platforms across CRM, DAM, dynamic creative optimisation (DCO), GenAI, marketing automation, email, social and analytics. Desirable Hands-on experience with both Tealium and Dynamic Yield. Experience with Adobe Campaign, Adobe Experience Platform or Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Experience with Google Tag Manager or Adobe Launch alongside Tealium. Background in E-commerce or direct-to-consumer (DTC) environments. Braze Certified Administrator, Tealium certification, or a demonstrable equivalent. Strong understanding of the MarTech landscape and a passion for customer engagement.
